summary: IHME LBD TB dashboard source API references
body:
Official IHME LBD tuberculosis explorer API references
Annual mortality aggregate time-series links for Ecuador national selection (public dashboard).
Male table Ecuador location 66 25-29 group (age 10) mortality measure:
 https://cors.bwa.workers.dev/https://vizhub.healthdata.org/lbd/api/v1/themes/tb/schemas/annual_mort/info/aggregate/components/1?location_id=66&measure=mort&sex=1&age=10&stat=mean&year_mort=2000
Female table same location and dimension:
 https://cors.bwa.workers.dev/https://vizhub.healthdata.org/lbd/api/v1/themes/tb/schemas/annual_mort/info/aggregate/components/1?location_id=66&measure=mort&sex=2&age=10&stat=mean&year_mort=2000
Configuration labels for dimension mapping:
 https://cors.bwa.workers.dev/https://vizhub.healthdata.org/lbd/api/v1/themes/tb/config
Interactive dashboard landing:
 https://vizhub.healthdata.org/lbd/tb
